title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 1:1-17
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 1:1-17</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: Rise of the Messiah (2024)
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="1:1" /> The scroll of the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange" word-lang="greek" word-original="γενεσις">birth-beginning  </char> of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Iesous Messiah</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        son of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Dauid</char>, son of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Abra’am</char>: 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="1" type="secondary">
      <group>
        <verse number="2" /> Abra’am<verse number="1" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange" word-lang="greek" word-original="γενναω">birthed  </char> Isaak, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Isaak<verse number="2" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Iakob, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Iakob<verse number="3" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">Iouda and his brothers</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="3" /> and Iouda<verse number="4" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Phares and Zara <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">from Tamar</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Phares<verse number="5" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Esrom, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Esrom<verse number="6" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Aram, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="4" /> and Aram<verse number="7" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Aminadab, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Aminadab<verse number="8" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Nasson, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Nasson<verse number="9" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Salmon, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="5" /> and Salmon<verse number="10" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Boes <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">from Rakhab</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Boes<verse number="11" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Iobed <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">from Ruth</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Iobed<verse number="12" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Iessai, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="6" /> and Iessai<verse number="13" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Dauid</char> <verse number="14," /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">the king,</char>
      </group>
      <group>
        and Dauid<verse number="14" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Solomon <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">from the one of Ouriah</char>, 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        <verse number="7" /> and Solomon<verse number="15" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Roboam, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Roboam<verse number="16" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Abia, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Abia<verse number="17" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Asaph, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="8" /> and Asaph<verse number="18" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Iosaphat, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Iosaphat<verse number="19" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Ioram, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Ioram<verse number="20" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Ozia, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="9" /> and Ozia<verse number="21" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Iotham, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Iotham<verse number="22" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Akhaz, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Akhaz<verse number="23" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Ezekia, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="10" /> and Ezekia<verse number="24" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Manasse, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Manasse<verse number="25" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Amos, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Amos<verse number="26" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Iosiah, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="11" /> and Iosia<verse number="27" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">Iekhonia</char> <verse number="28" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">and his brothers</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        until <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">the exile of Babylon</char>. 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        <verse number="12" /> After <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">the exile of Babylon</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        Iekhonia<verse number="28" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Salathiel, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Salathiel<verse number="29" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Zorobabel, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="13" /> and Zorobabel<verse number="30" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Abioud, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Abioud<verse number="31" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Eliakim, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Eliakim<verse number="32" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Azor, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="14" /> and Azor<verse number="33" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Sadok, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Sadok<verse number="34" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Akhim, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Akhim<verse number="35" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Elioud, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="15" /> and Elioud<verse number="36" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Eleazar, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Eleazar<verse number="37" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Matthan, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Matthan<verse number="38" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Iakob, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="16" /> and Iakob<verse number="39" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Ioseph<verse number="40," /> the husband of <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">Maria</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">from</char> whom was <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Iesous</char> <verse number="41," /> 
      </group>
      <group>
        who is called “Messiah.” 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="17" /> All the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange" word-lang="greek" word-original="γενεα">birth-generations  </char> from <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Abra’am</char> until <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Dauid</char>: fourteen <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birth-generations</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and from Dauid until <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">the exile of Babylon</char>: fourteen <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birth-generations</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and from <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">the exile of Babylon</char> until <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">the Messiah</char>: fourteen <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birth-generations</char>. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
